nodes.label: FR-PROD-002
nodes.rationale: A product cannot be deleted (only deactivated) once it has any stock movement or transaction reference, enforced at the service layer, not just a DB constraint.

nodes.label: FR-PROD-003
nodes.rationale: Products are shared master data: both Royal Hardware and M52 reference the same Product record.

nodes.label: FR-PROD-006 (Weighted Average Cost)
nodes.rationale: Average Cost recalculated on every Purchase via Weighted Average Cost, computed per warehouse since a product's average cost can legitimately differ by warehouse; flagged as an assumption pending confirmation.

nodes.label: FR-PROD-007
nodes.rationale: Architecture must allow future price tiers (Retail vs Wholesale) without schema redesign, even though only one tier is required now.

nodes.label: FR-PROD-008
nodes.rationale: Minimum/Maximum Stock thresholds are per warehouse per product, not global.

nodes.label: FR-UNIT-002 (transitive unit conversion)
nodes.rationale: Conversions are transitive within a product's defined unit chain; the system resolves any-to-any conversion by multiplying factors along the path rather than requiring every pair defined explicitly.

nodes.label: FR-UNIT-003
nodes.rationale: Conversion factors are defined per product, not globally per unit pair.

nodes.label: FR-STK-001
nodes.rationale: There is no direct 'edit stock quantity' action anywhere - every stock change comes from a typed movement (Purchase, Sale, Transfer, Adjustment, Return, Damage, Correction).

nodes.label: FR-XFER-001
nodes.rationale: A Stock Transfer always creates two linked movements (outbound from A, inbound to B) sharing one Transfer reference number.

nodes.label: FR-XFER-002
nodes.rationale: Transfer workflow states Initiated -> In Transit -> Received (or Rejected); stock leaves source on-hand immediately but only appears in destination on-hand once Received.

nodes.label: FR-XFER-003
nodes.rationale: Partial receipt creates a variance that must be resolved via a Stock Adjustment with reason 'Transfer Variance'.

nodes.label: FR-SALE-001
nodes.rationale: One Sales table for all channels, with Sales Channel stored as a lookup so a channel can be added via Settings without a migration.

nodes.label: FR-SALE-002
nodes.rationale: Each Sales Channel maps to exactly one Company for ledger/GST purposes, configurable in Settings rather than hardcoded.

nodes.label: FR-SALE-004
nodes.rationale: A Sale cannot post exceeding available stock unless an explicit Admin-only 'Allow Negative Stock' override is used and logged.

nodes.label: FR-QUO-002
nodes.rationale: Converting a Quotation to an Invoice supports partial conversion; the Quotation remains open for the unconverted remainder.

nodes.label: FR-QUO-003
nodes.rationale: A Quotation does not affect stock or ledgers until converted - it is a non-transactional document.

nodes.label: FR-USER-002
nodes.rationale: Roles are data-driven records; Permissions are granular per-module actions assigned to Roles, not hardcoded per user.

nodes.label: FR-USER-003
nodes.rationale: Default seeded Roles: Admin (all permissions) and Salesman (restricted, explicitly denied Cost Price/Average Cost/Profit/Purchases/Expenses/Supplier Ledger/Users/Roles/Settings).

nodes.label: FR-USER-010
nodes.rationale: Cost/margin visibility is enforced at the API layer, not just hidden in UI - a Salesman-scoped request must never receive cost fields in the response payload.

nodes.label: FR-AUDIT-001
nodes.rationale: Every Create/Update/Delete writes an Audit Log entry with user, table/record, old/new value JSON, timestamp, IP, user agent, and reason (required for Deletes/Adjustments).

nodes.label: FR-WA-001
nodes.rationale: Integrates with the official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API using pre-approved templates for Invoice, Quotation, Ledger Statement, Outstanding Reminder, Payment Confirmation, Order Confirmation.

nodes.label: FR-BAK-001
nodes.rationale: Manual and Automatic Daily Backup produce a CSV export set and ZIP archive, optionally uploaded to Google Drive via OAuth.
